mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near City Hall with a temperature of 56 degrees and a New Moon overhead.
In city news, the Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide development, and the city continues to maintain its strong Moody's Aa1 financial rating.
There is plenty to do with live music today at both Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, an officer conducted a traffic stop on October 3 that resulted in the arrest of a 19-year-old man and the recovery of a stolen firearm.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Caramel Cashew. The store is currently closed, but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
